idea-plugin.name: javafmt
idea-plugin.description:
An opinionated, zero-configuration Java formatter.

The plugin replaces IntelliJ's built-in Java formatter when a project applies the dev.javafmt.gradle plugin. Reformat Code and format-on-save both route through javafmt automatically — there is nothing new to invoke.

  • Zero configuration. No style options, no .editorconfig overrides.
  • Version is pinned by the Gradle plugin, so every contributor on the project formats with the same javafmt build.
  • Falls back transparently to the built-in formatter for projects that don't use javafmt.

See the project on GitHub for the Gradle plugin, the CLI, and the style guide.
idea-plugin.change-notes: • Initial release. Adds javafmt-based Java formatting, sourced from the dev.javafmt.gradle Gradle plugin applied to the project.
